about: Voices for singer source 'svs' (engine/svs.py). Pick one with "voice": "<id>". Descriptions, measurements and auditions: docs/voice/VOICES.md. Every voice here is licence-clean for Spectre's CC BY 4.0 tracks only with the credit line given; never use a Lotte V voice in a track with a political subject. The male voices (`hanami-male`, `hanami-male-es`; approved by the owner by ear, 2026-11-25) are Hanami sung an octave up and moved down inside the synthesizer (`sing_up`): Hanami's credit and terms apply.

voices.settings: hanami-male singing Spanish (`"lang": "es"`); lyrics hyphenated by Spanish syllables, as for hanami-es

controls.gender: -1..1 (0): formant shift; negative = formants down (darker, larger, older), positive = up (brighter, younger). Measured on hanami: -0.5 F1/F2 617/987 -> 498/1009 Hz. Not a male voice by itself: at -1 with the line written an octave down the pitch model wobbles and the words are lost (examples/vocals/svs/voices/ctl-hanami-male-fake.mp3). `hanami-male` is the measured way: gender -0.2 with the octave moved inside the synthesizer.
controls.velocity: 0.5..2 (1): consonant speed; small effect on these banks
controls.mix: a voice entry may give "mix": {mode: weight} instead of "mode" to blend vocal modes (speaker embeddings interpolated)
controls.not available: these banks have no breathiness, tension, voicing or energy controls (their models were trained without them)
controls.lang: "en" (default) or "es" (Hanami only): the language the lyrics are read in. A voice id may set it (hanami-es, hanami-es-soft); a track's `lang` overrides it. Spanish: engine/lang_es.py, docs/voice/languages/es.md
controls.sing_up: hanami-male, hanami-male-es: a voice entry's "sing_up" (semitones) makes the bank's duration and pitch models sing that far above the written notes, inside its trained register; the pitch curve is moved back down before the acoustic model and the vocoder (no other model), and the voice's `gender` (-0.2) lowers the formants. Lotte V's terms name this as allowed: a derivative voice made with the synthesizer's own settings.
